title: Chat answers before tool results are visible: no live tool SSE events + pre-tool narration
description:
The streamed turn makes the companion look like it answers before its tools run.

Three contributing causes:
1. The model narrates BEFORE calling a tool ('Nezzuk meg...', 'Most megprobalom megnezni...'). That preamble streams first and is persisted as part of the answer. ChatService.SYSTEM_PROMPT (service/ChatService.java:46-69) has no rule against pre-tool narration.
2. Tool chips and refs are back-filled at the very end. The wire carries exactly three events - delta/done/error (service/ChatStreamService.java:42-44) - and the FE's streaming bubble passes only {role, ts, text} (frontend ChatPage.tsx:73), so chips (ChatMessage.tsx:47) can only come from the terminal done payload. The whole tool phase renders as undifferentiated ThinkingDots.
3. At done the FE discards the streamed draft and renders the authoritative row (chatHooks.ts:97,102-104), which CompanionAdvisorChain.review (advisor/CompanionAdvisorChain.java:48-71) may have entirely rewritten in a non-streamed corrective round - so the text visibly swaps.

Verified NOT the cause: Spring AI's streaming tool loop is correct - GoogleGenAiChatModel.internalStream recurses with the tool result and streams the continuation.
acceptance_criteria: New 'tool' SSE event on the companion stream contract (api/feature/companion), emitted from the RecordingToolCallback choke point as each tool actually executes, with the same pre-baked 'name(args)' label as CompanionMapper; FE renders live tool chips during the stream; SYSTEM_PROMPT forbids pre-tool narration (call the tool first, answer from the result); backend + FE tests in both modes; docs/features/companion.md streaming section updated

title: get_recipes cannot find a recipe by its name or ingredients
description:
FuelTools.matchesRecipeFilter (tools/FuelTools.java:372-386) matches only slot/category/tag/starred/fitsFor and deliberately NOT the recipe name. The comment cites 'spec R1', but that section does not exist anywhere in docs/ (nor in git history) - the real 'Recipe R1' in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-26-companion-tool-context-expansion.md:50 is the generic hub-tool boilerplate pattern, unrelated to filtering. So the exclusion is undocumented and unjustified.

Consequences:
- 'a smoothie collagen a receptek kozul' -> 'Receptek - "smoothie collagen": nincs adat' even when that recipe exists (real chat, 2026-07-29).
- ingredients[].name is in the same RecipeResponse the tool already holds, so 'mit fozzek csirkevel' / 'van valami turos' can never match either. role is unused too.
- Even a correct literal name cannot work reliably: a two-word needle is matched as ONE substring, so 'smoothie collagen' misses a recipe named 'Collagen Smoothie'.

Incidental defect in the same method: the starred branch (:380-382) matches bidirectionally (k.contains(needle) || needle.contains(k)), so any short needle that is a substring of 'csillagos'/'kedvenc'/'starred' (e.g. 'a', 'cs', 'red') matches EVERY starred recipe.

The filter-miss branch (:320) has zero test coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Token-based, accent-folded (NFD) scored matching over name + ingredient names + tags + category + slot + role + fitsFor; multi-word needles match in any order; best match wins the detail render; starred keyword match is exact-token (no bidirectional substring); @Tool/@ToolParam descriptions state what is actually matched (companion_tool_conventions.md); ITs cover name match, ingredient match, multi-word any-order match, the starred regression and the miss branch; docs/features/companion.md tool catalog updated
close_reason: scored accent-folded token match over name/ingredients/tags/category/slot/role/fitsFor; all-token hits win; best scorer renders detail; starred whole-token only; 5 ITs, 4 verified red-then-green

title: Companion is blind to scheduled sport on a given date
description:
get_training_plan renders only gym + running for today/tomorrow/week/date: TrainTools.dayContentLine (tools/TrainTools.java:276-295) never consults sport_schedule_slot, and SportService is not even injected (TrainTools.java:54-69). A volleyball evening renders 'gym: pihenonap', and the NO_DATA guard (:250, :263) can claim 'nincs adat' for a day that has a scheduled sport slot.

ContextSnapshotAssembler is asymmetric for the same reason: tomorrowLine (:283-311) adds sport + run, todayLine (:259-274) is gym-only. So 'Ma' under-reports and the model has to derive today's sport from the trailing raw weekly 'sport-rend' pattern (:230-234) - exactly the hallucination path the dated resolution was meant to remove.

Repro (real chat, 2026-07-29): 'mai napomrol mit latsz?' listed only the Full Body gym day; only when pushed with 'sport?' did the model derive '18:00, 120 perc' from the weekly pattern.
acceptance_criteria: get_training_plan scope=today|tomorrow|week|date renders the date's sport schedule slots (sport, time, kind, duration); a sport-only day is never 'nincs adat' and never bare 'pihenonap'; ContextSnapshotAssembler.todayLine renders sport + run symmetrically with tomorrowLine; focused ITs cover a sport-only day and a gym+sport day; docs/features/companion.md updated
close_reason: get_training_plan renders the date's sport slots; todayLine/tomorrowLine unified into one dayLine; shared ToolText.sportLine; 5 ITs verified red-then-green
